title: Butter Chicken
description: Tandoor-grilled chicken simmered in a rich, buttery tomato-cashew gravy — a restaurant classic that's easier to make at home than it looks.

ingredients.name: Kasuri Methi
ingredients.notes: dried fenugreek leaves, crushed between palms

steps: Marinate the chicken in curd, half the ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder, half the garam masala and 1 tsp salt for at least 30 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Heat 1 tbsp butter in a pan and sear the marinated chicken pieces over high heat until browned on the outside (they don't need to be cooked through yet). Set aside.
In the same pan, add the remaining butter, onion, tomatoes, cashews and remaining ginger-garlic paste. Cook covered on medium heat for 15-20 minutes until the tomatoes are completely soft.
Let the mixture cool slightly, then blend to a smooth puree. Pass through a sieve for an extra-smooth gravy if desired.
Return the puree to the pan, add the Kashmiri chilli powder and remaining salt, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the seared chicken back in and simmer for 10-15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the gravy has thickened.
Stir in the cream, remaining garam masala and crushed kasuri methi. Simmer for another 2-3 minutes and serve hot.
